text:
Predicates:
RatedAboveFour(x) ::: x has a rating greater than four.
YelpRecommended(x) ::: x is listed in Yelp's recommendations.
ManyNegativeReviews(x) ::: x has received many negative reviews.
ProvidesTakeOut(x) ::: x provides take-out service.
PopularLocals(x) ::: x is popular among local residents.
Store(x) ::: x is a store.
Premises:
∀x (YelpRecommended(x) → ¬ManyNegativeReviews(x)) ::: If a restaurant is listed in Yelp's recommendations, then it has not received many negative reviews.
∀x (RatedAboveFour(x) → YelpRecommended(x)) ::: All restaurants with a rating greater than four are listed in Yelp's recommendations.
∃x (¬ProvidesTakeOut(x) ∧ ManyNegativeReviews(x)) ::: Some restaurants that do not provide take-out service receive many negative reviews.
∀x (PopularLocals(x) → RatedAboveFour(x)) ::: All restaurants that are popular among local residents have ratings greater than four.
RatedAboveFour(HamdenPlazaSubway) ∨ PopularLocals(HamdenPlazaSubway) ::: The Hamden Plaza Subway store has a rating greater than four, or it is popular among local residents.
Conclusion:
¬ProvidesTakeOut(HamdenPlazaSubway) ::: The Hamden Plaza store does not provide take-out service.
